name: gitea
description: Declares the complete public Gitea REST API v1 source surface. All provider operations remain disabled until connector-owned schemas, fixtures, and typed executor contracts are derived from the pinned public document.

risk.read: No Gitea request is executable in this declaration-only bundle; future reads must be bounded by connector-owned schemas, pagination, fixtures, and conformance evidence.
risk.write: No Gitea write is executable. The pinned source includes destructive and administrative operations that require typed reverse-ETL records, approval, and destructive confirmation before enablement.
risk.approval: Any future write must use plan, preview, explicit approval, execute, and typed destructive confirmation where the documented operation removes provider state.
